decisions.contract: docs/specs/utf8-validation.md section 2: readable byte buffer of count 0 through 0x7FFFFFFF, nonwrapping 32-bit pointer-plus-count; byte count, no sentinel-length mode.
decisions.production: engine/core/src/utf8_validation.rs: MAX_COUNT = 0x7fff_ffff; check_count(count) rejects count > MAX_COUNT; utf8_is_string_valid calls check_count(bytes.len())? before walk(bytes.len(), |offset| bytes[offset]).
decisions.assertion: engine/core/src/utf8_validation/tests.rs: count_domain_is_distinct_from_false_without_allocating_gigabytes asserts check_count(0), check_count(MAX_COUNT) are Ok(()), MAX_COUNT + 1 and usize::MAX are Err(UnsupportedCount), and [0xff] is Ok(false). Synthetic predicate checks, not giant-buffer execution.

decisions.contract: docs/specs/utf8-validation.md sections 2, 3, 5.4: Empty input succeeds; count zero accepted without reading; NUL inside span consumed as ordinary one-byte value; bytes beyond count irrelevant.
decisions.production: engine/core/src/utf8_validation.rs: walk sets current = 0, while current < count; utf8_is_string_valid reads bytes[offset] in exactly the supplied slice, 0x00..=0x7f => 1.
decisions.assertion: engine/core/src/utf8_validation/tests.rs: public_107_literal_cases checks V01-V03 and S01-S07 using &case.backing[..case.count]; no_reads_on_empty_and_no_continuation_reads_on_all_15_truncations requires V01/S01 [] and S07 [0]; public_stopping_and_lower_bound_read_order checks S02-S06 exact read lists.

decisions.contract: docs/specs/utf8-validation.md section 3: eight inclusive unsigned lead rows 00..7F, 80..C1, C2..DF, E0..EF, F0..F7, F8..FB, FC..FD, FE..FF.
decisions.production: engine/core/src/utf8_validation.rs: walk match lead selects widths 1,2,3,4,5,6 and immediately returns false for 0x80..=0xc1 | 0xfe..=0xff; read returns u8.
decisions.assertion: engine/core/src/utf8_validation/tests.rs: public_107_literal_cases, CASES V02-V44 cover lead edges, stray continuations, C0/C1, FE/FF, extrema and historical/non-scalar contrasts. Exhaustiveness for interior leads comes from disjoint complete match ranges and the independent static argument in utf8-review.md.

decisions.contract: docs/specs/utf8-validation.md sections 3, 5.2: remaining count must first be at least total width; if shorter fail before reading any continuation.
decisions.production: engine/core/src/utf8_validation.rs: if count - current < width { return false; } precedes for position in 1..width.
decisions.assertion: engine/core/src/utf8_validation/tests.rs: no_reads_on_empty_and_no_continuation_reads_on_all_15_truncations uses assert_reads(case.id, &[0]) for all T rows and S07; CASES T01-T15 encode all fifteen shorter widths, and public_107_literal_cases checks false.

decisions.contract: docs/specs/utf8-validation.md sections 3, 5.3: inspect continuations in ascending position order, reject first byte outside 80..BF; no later continuation or lower-bound condition examined.
decisions.production: engine/core/src/utf8_validation.rs: for position in 1..width reads current + position; !(0x80..=0xbf).contains(&byte) immediately returns false.
decisions.assertion: engine/core/src/utf8_validation/tests.rs: all_30_bad_continuations_stop_at_first_bad_position has literal B01/7F through B15/C0 pairs and read lists [0,1] through [0,1,2,3,4,5]; assert_reads checks result and reads, and asserts offset < case.count. S10/S11 have same early rejection with different unread suffixes.

decisions.contract: docs/specs/utf8-validation.md sections 3, 5.4: extra condition only after all continuations pass; low E0 first continuation 80 is structurally valid and does not skip checking position 2.
decisions.production: engine/core/src/utf8_validation.rs: if position == 1 { first = byte; } only caches; exceptional minimum block appears after continuation loop, under if width >= 3.
decisions.assertion: engine/core/src/utf8_validation/tests.rs: public_stopping_and_lower_bound_read_order asserts S12 [0,1,2,0], S13 [0,1,2], S14 [0,1,2,3,0], S15 [0,1,2,3,4,0], S16 [0,1,2,3,4,5,0].

decisions.contract: docs/specs/utf8-validation.md section 3 plus section 5.4 ordered traces: re-read lead for additional condition; E0 requires A0, F0 requires 90, F8 requires 88, FC requires 84 at first continuation.
decisions.production: engine/core/src/utf8_validation.rs: match read(current) selects 0xe0 => 0xa0, 0xf0 => 0x90, 0xf8 => 0x88, 0xfc => 0x84, _ => 0x80; if first < minimum { return false; } uses cached first without another continuation read.
decisions.assertion: engine/core/src/utf8_validation/tests.rs: public_107_literal_cases contrasts V10/V11, V15/V16, V23/V24, V28/V29 and default leads V13/V18/V26/V31; S12/S14/S15/S16 literal traces require actual lead re-read after all continuations; S13 forbids re-read on earlier continuation failure. Successful default-lead re-read for arbitrary lead values is a static obligation, not an exhaustive trace-fixture claim.

decisions.contract: docs/specs/utf8-validation.md section 3: advance current and reduce remaining by exactly width on success; on rejection stop immediately without advancing past lead or inspecting later bytes.
decisions.production: engine/core/src/utf8_validation.rs: current += width is after every rejecting return; no rejecting branch updates current or loops again.
decisions.assertion: engine/core/src/utf8_validation/tests.rs: public_107_literal_cases includes S17 accepted widths 1,2,3,4,5,6,1 total 22 and S18 false after next stray continuation; public_stopping_and_lower_bound_read_order checks S08/S09 [0,1], S10/S11 [0,1], S18 [0,1,2].

decisions.contract: docs/specs/utf8-validation.md sections 2, 3: Boolean AL 1 exactly at calculated end; success requires entire counted span; every supported iteration consumes at least one byte and no more than remaining count.
decisions.production: engine/core/src/utf8_validation.rs: while current < count, guarded exact current += width, final true. Invariant current <= count <= MAX_COUNT and strict decrease of count-current establish equality at exit, termination and no overflow/out-of-span reads.
decisions.assertion: engine/core/src/utf8_validation/tests.rs: public_107_literal_cases checks empty V01, mixed S17 and leftover S18, while assert_reads checks in-span offsets. Universal induction in docs/coverage-functions/utf8-review.md supplies all lengths/interior-byte obligations beyond finite fixtures.

decisions.contract: docs/specs/utf8-validation.md sections 2, 4: no output writes or calls, no noncharacter/scalar/code-point upper-bound/normalization test; accepts five/six-byte forms, surrogates and above-modern-maximum values.
decisions.production: engine/core/src/utf8_validation.rs: utf8_is_string_valid returns Result<bool, UnsupportedCount>; walk only reads raw bytes and modifies local traversal state, uses no foreign validator, writes, allocation, unsafe access or scalar decoder.
decisions.assertion: engine/core/src/utf8_validation/tests.rs: public_107_literal_cases V14, V19-V22, V24-V32, V35-V38 cover noncharacter, modern-boundary, historical-width and surrogate-neighbor acceptances. No-writes/foreign-dependency claim is source dataflow analysis, not inferred from test count.
